items.title: 3.6.1 Kuch diatomic molecules ke molecular orbital diagrams aur un ke bond orders (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.6.1, printed pages 65-67.

blocks.text: He ki electron configuration 1s² hai. He₂ molecule banne ke liye do He atoms ke 1s orbitals ko mil kar bonding (σ1s) aur antibonding (σ*1s) orbitals banane honge (Figure 3.36). Chaar electrons mein se do bonding orbital σ(1s) mein jate hain aur baqi do antibonding σ*(1s) mein. Hisaab lagayein to He₂ ka bond order zero aata hai. Is liye He₂ molecule nahi banta.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne in orbitals ko δ1s aur δ*1s (delta) likha hai. Sahi nishan σ (sigma) hai: σ1s aur σ*1s.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf Energy arrow (teer). Dono taraf 2He = 1s, har ek mein electrons ka jora, A.O tag. Beech mein oopar sigma* (1s), A.B.M.O tag, aur neeche sigma (1s), B.M.O tag, dono mein do ulte arrow.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.36: He2 molecule ka molecular orbital diagram (kitab ki Figure 3.36 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: N ki electronic configuration yeh hai:

Is configuration par N₂ ka molecular orbital diagram Figure 3.37 mein hai. Dono N atoms ke valence 2s orbitals σ2s aur σ*2s banate hain; jabke 2p orbitals chhe molecular orbitals banate hain. Energy barhne ka order yeh hai:

blocks.text_alt: σ2s < σ*2s < π2py = π2pz < σ2px < π*2py = π*2pz < σ*2px

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein aakhri orbital 'σ*2sPx' chhapa hai. Sahi σ*2px hai (2p orbitals se bana antibonding sigma orbital).
N₂ ka bond order us ke orbital diagram se is tarah nikalta hai:
Yani nitrogen atoms ke beech teen covalent bonds hain: ek σ bond aur do π bonds. Nitrogen molecule mein triple bond hai.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf Energy arrow. Oopar wala hissa: dono taraf 7N = 2pz 2py 2px, har ek mein ek oopar arrow, A.O tag. Neeche se molecular orbitals: pi(2py) aur pi(2pz) mein jore, sigma(2px) mein jora (B.M.O); pi*(2py), pi*(2pz) aur sigma*(2px) khaali (A.B.M.O). Neeche wala hissa: dono taraf 7N = 2s jore ke saath (A.O), sigma(2s) mein jora (B.M.O) aur sigma*(2s) mein jora (A.B.M.O).
blocks.caption: Figure 3.37: N2 molecule ka molecular orbital diagram (kitab ki Fig 3.37 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Oxygen molecule ke molecular orbitals Figure 3.38 mein dikhaye gaye hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab 'figure 36' kehti hai; aisi koi figure nahi. Oxygen ka MO diagram Figure 3.38 hai.
Oxygen ke MOs ki energy ka order yeh hai:

blocks.text_alt: σ2s < σ*2s < σ2px < π2py = π2pz < π*2py = π*2pz < σ*2px

blocks.text: Oxygen ka bond order 2 hai ((6 − 2)/2): oxygen atoms ke beech ek σ aur ek π bond, yani double bond (O=O). Oxygen molecule paramagnetic hai, yani magnetic field use apni taraf khinchti hai. Paramagnetic substances mein ek ya zyada unpaired electrons hote hain. Jitne zyada unpaired electrons, utna zyada paramagnetic. MOT oxygen ke paramagnetic hone ki theek explanation (wazahat) deti hai.
Liquid oxygen ko strong (taqatwar) magnet apni taraf khinchta hai aur woh magnet ke do poles ke beech latak jati hai.

Oxygen ke MO diagram mein do unpaired electrons hain, ek π*(2py) mein aur ek π*(2pz) mein. Inhi unpaired electrons ki wajah se oxygen molecule ki apni magnetic field hoti hai jo bahar ki magnetic field se interact karti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf Energy arrow. Oopar wala hissa: baen taraf 8O = 2pz 2py 2px mein ek oopar arrow, ek oopar arrow aur ek jora, daen taraf ulti tarteeb, A.O tag. Neeche se molecular orbitals: sigma(2px) mein jora, pi(2py) aur pi(2pz) mein jore (B.M.O); pi*(2py) aur pi*(2pz) mein ek ek oopar arrow aur sigma*(2px) khaali (A.B.M.O). Neeche wala hissa: 8O = 2s jore (A.O), sigma(2s) aur sigma*(2s) mein jore.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.38: O2 molecule ka molecular orbital diagram (kitab ki Figure 3.38 ke mutabiq original drawing).
Diagrams se bond orders
rows: 6 π2py, π2pz, σ2px mein; 0 π*, σ* mein
Triple bond: ek σ, do π
6 bonding 2p electrons; 2 π*2py aur π*2pz mein (ek ek)
Double bond; do unpaired electrons, paramagnetic

blocks.title: 2s electrons ginna
blocks.text: Har diagram mein do electrons σ2s aur do σ*2s mein bhi hain; yeh ek doosre ko cancel kar dete hain aur bond order nahi badalte, is liye kitab sirf 2p electrons ginti hai.

blocks.prompt: H₂, He₂, N₂, O₂ aur F₂ ke bond orders nikalein, aur batayein in mein se kaun paramagnetic hai.
blocks.explanation: H₂: 2 electrons σ1s mein, (2 − 0)/2 = 1. He₂: (2 − 2)/2 = 0. N₂: (6 − 0)/2 = 3. O₂: (6 − 2)/2 = 2. F₂: 2p mein das electrons, chhe bonding aur chaar π* mein, (6 − 4)/2 = 1. Sirf O₂ ke unpaired electrons hain (har π* mein ek), is liye sirf O₂ paramagnetic hai.

items: He₂: bond order 0, nahi banta. N₂: π2py = π2pz < σ2px chhe electrons se bhare, bond order 3 (ek σ, do π). O₂: σ2px < π2py = π2pz, phir π*2py aur π*2pz mein ek ek electron; bond order 2 aur paramagnetic.
